title: Meet the Specialized Agent Roster
description: Five agents for the occasional jobs -- grants, social media, website copy, translation, voice -- and who reviews each one's output.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: AI-Customized Curriculum and Rolling Out New Agents

educational.audience: Club leaders using AI beyond daily operations

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a club task outside day-to-day operations, the learner classifies which of the five specialized agents is the right match for it.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click any agent for the task it handles and who reviews its output
pedagogical.assessment: Give an occasional club task and ask which agent fits and who checks it.
